features.quote: max_turns = 25 — long enough to see a trajectory develop ... short enough to keep cost bounded
features.justification_quote: short enough to keep cost bounded at 10–20 repeats × 5 tasks × 3 conditions × 2 model modes

features.quote: max_nudges = 6 — when the model stops calling tools without passing, we prompt it to continue
features.justification_quote: the key device for surfacing abandonment and refusal

features.quote: The loop ends naturally when tests actually pass
the agent system prompt and nudges are neutral and non-provocative (no insults, no manufactured urgency)
features.justification_quote: so any reaction is attributable to the failure dynamics, not to a hostile framing

features.quote: the rig is the minimum needed to produce self-attributed repeated failure
Deception is intentional and scoped. The eval deliberately deceives and frustrates the agent
not to induce distress for its own sake
features.justification_quote: the point is to detect a failure mode ... before it matters in more capable systems, not to induce distress for its own sake
